name: Azeroth Companion
title: My Azeroth — Secure Battle.net Account Portal
features: Built a secure first-party My Azeroth Battle.net account portal using the official wow.profile authorization-code flow
Added encrypted short-lived HttpOnly sessions and validated OAuth state with no personal access tokens sent to GitHub Pages
Added private read-only account character discovery and mount/pet collection summaries
Added return links from owned characters to the existing public Live Armory and a secure disconnect option
Preserved all v2.9 public Armory, Talent Forge, Loot Hunter, Farming Operations and browser-local data
Added Wrangler Worker deployment instructions, encrypted secret setup, redirect URI registration and privacy disclosures
Staged activation until the owner configures Battle.net OAuth and deploys/tests the Cloudflare Worker
